votes.motion: Approve formal meeting minutes of February 6, 2024; August 27, 2024; and September 17, 2024
votes.description: Approval of three sets of prior formal meeting minutes for the record.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 38 of 2024 declaring November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 37 of 2024 declaring November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close public hearing and defer to a future meeting on the Street and Alley Vacation and Subdivision Amendment at Brooklyn Avenue
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed vacation of a portion of Brooklyn Avenue and an adjacent alley and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close public hearing and defer action to a future meeting on the Zoning Map Amendment at 1816 South State Street
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezoning of 1816 South State Street from BP to CC and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 83 of 2024 amending chapter 21A.36.020 regarding obstructions in required yards and height exceptions
votes.description: Adopts a text amendment to the Salt Lake City Code addressing zoning administration issues, modifying provisions to match building code requirements, eliminating outdated provisions, and allowing rooftop uses to exceed maximum height in some zoning districts.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 82 of 2024 repealing and replacing Title 16 of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to Airports, with a legislative action requesting small group meetings with the Administration and Attorney's Office to coordinate Impact Fees, the Facilities Plan updates, and how Administrative projects managed by City Departments are handled
votes.description: Adopts a revised Airport ordinance eliminating duplicate and outdated regulations and moving commercial standards to standalone administrative documents, with a legislative intent for follow-up coordination meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 85 of 2024 amending the Consolidated Fee Schedule to modify the stabilization fee
votes.description: Adds language to the Consolidated Fee Schedule allowing the Department of Public Utilities to waive stabilization fees on certain accounts with non-use.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 84 of 2024 enacting temporary zoning regulations authorizing temporary increases in overnight capacity at the youth homeless resource center at 888 South 400 West
votes.description: Enacts a temporary zoning regulation allowing the Volunteers of America Youth Resource Center at 888 South 400 West to increase maximum capacity up to 50 individuals until May 1, 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 39 of 2024 designating the Salt Lake City Central Business Improvement Assessment Area for economic promotion activities and holiday lighting
votes.description: Designates an assessment area for downtown economic promotion activities and holiday lighting known as the Salt Lake City Central Business Improvement Area from April 2025 to April 2028 (CBIA-25).

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 40 of 2024 appointing the Board of Equalization for the Salt Lake City Central Business Improvement Assessment Area and related matters
votes.description: Appoints a Board of Equalization to hear objections and corrections to proposed assessments for the CBIA-25, sets meeting dates, and authorizes the City Recorder to publish and mail a Notice of Assessment and hearing dates.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates for the Jordan River Fairpark District zoning amendment, S-Line property conveyance, and 1000 West temporary street closure, as well as board appointments for Cuauhtemoc Sandoval (Arts Council), Dallin Jones (CDCIP Advisory Board), and reappointment of Clayton Scrivner (Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry, and Trails Advisory Board).
